scripts.build:deploy: rm -rf .next .prisma prisma/.prisma && npm run db:setup && npm run db:push && npm run build
scripts.postinstall: if [ "$NODE_ENV" = "production" ]; then npm run build:deploy; fi
scripts.prestart: rm -f src/middleware.ts src/proxy.ts && [ -d .next ] || npm run build:deploy
scripts.start: sh -c 'NODE_ENV=production PRISMA_CLIENT_ENGINE_TYPE=library node runtime-init.js && NODE_ENV=production PRISMA_CLIENT_ENGINE_TYPE=library node index.js'
